content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To use sponge rollers, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Unclip the plastic frames from the sponge rollers (2 minutes)
Step 2. Apply a light mist of water to the first section (30 seconds)
Step 3. Smooth the ends of the hair over the sponge (1 minute)
Step 4. Snap the locking clip into place (15 seconds)
Step 5. Gather all necessary rollers on the vanity (2 minutes)
Step 6. Plug in the hooded dryer (1 minute)
Step 7. Section off the top crown area (3 minutes)
Step 8. Spray a firm-hold finishing lacquer (45 seconds)
Step 9. Roll the sponge tightly toward the scalp (2 minutes)
Step 10. Check the tension of the hair on the roller (30 seconds)
Step 11. Brush out any tangles in the hair (5 minutes)
Step 12. Apply a dollop of setting mousse (1 minute)
Step 13. Divide the back section into three horizontal rows (4 minutes)
Step 14. Organize rollers by size (3 minutes)
Step 15. Allow the hair to air dry completely (4 hours)
Step 16. Prepare a tail comb for precise parting (1 minute)
Step 17. Wash hair with a clarifying shampoo (10 minutes)
Step 18. Apply a heat protectant spray (1 minute)
Step 19. Position the roller at the very ends of the hair (45 seconds)
Step 20. Towel dry hair until it is damp (8 minutes)
Step 21. Select the medium-sized rollers for the sides (1 minute)
Step 22. Rub a smoothing serum between palms (30 seconds)
Step 23. Distribute serum through the hair lengths (2 minutes)
Step 24. Roll the side sections away from the face (5 minutes)
Step 25. Part the hair down the center (2 minutes)
Step 26. Comb through the setting mousse for even distribution (3 minutes)
Step 27. Lay out a soft towel over the shoulders (1 minute)
Step 28. Set a timer for the drying process (30 seconds)
Step 29. Apply a deep conditioner (15 minutes)
Step 30. Section the hair into one-inch squares (10 minutes)
Step 31. Secure the front bangs with a small roller (2 minutes)
Step 32. Wrap the hair around the sponge cylinder (2 minutes)
Step 33. Clean the rollers with warm soapy water (10 minutes)
Step 34. Check that hair ends are not bent or "fish-hooked" (1 minute)
Step 35. Mist each section with a setting spray (1 minute)
Step 36. Use the tail comb to create a clean horizontal part (2 minutes)
Step 37. Rinse out the conditioner with cool water (5 minutes)
Step 38. Inspect the rollers for any foam tears (2 minutes)
Step 39. Position the rollers vertically for spiral curls (3 minutes)
Step 40. Buy a new pack of sponge rollers (1 hour)
Step 41. Sort out the larger rollers for the bottom (2 minutes)
Step 42. Ensure the roller is sitting flush against the head (30 seconds)
Step 43. Untangle the cord of the hair dryer (1 minute)
Step 44. Apply a light hair oil to the tips (2 minutes)
Step 45. Read the instructions on the roller packaging (5 minutes)
Step 46. Sit under the hooded dryer (45 minutes)
Step 47. Check the moisture level of the hair (1 minute)
Step 48. Remove the rollers one by one (5 minutes)
Step 49. Apply a volumizing root lift spray (2 minutes)
Step 50. Dry the rollers with a clean cloth (3 minutes)
Step 51. Brush the hair into a smooth ponytail base (4 minutes)
Step 52. Finger-comb the curls to soften them (3 minutes)
Step 53. Put on a silk bonnet to protect the set (2 minutes)
Step 54. Shake out the curls for more volume (1 minute)
Step 55. Secure the rollers with bobby pins if loose (5 minutes)
Step 56. Distribute a pea-sized amount of pomade (2 minutes)
Step 57. Spray a shine-enhancing mist (30 seconds)
Step 58. Clean the vanity area (10 minutes)
Step 59. Let the curls cool down to room temperature (20 minutes)
Step 60. Divide the left side into two sub-sections (3 minutes)
Step 61. Comb the section straight up from the scalp (1 minute)
Step 62. Warm up the room to speed up drying (15 minutes)
Step 63. Gather all hair clips and ties (5 minutes)
Step 64. Fasten the plastic clasp over the hair (30 seconds)
Step 65. Double check that no hair is caught in the hinge (1 minute)
Step 66. Plug in a handheld mirror to see the back (2 minutes)
Step 67. Adjust the rollers for comfort (2 minutes)
Step 68. Put on a comfortable robe (3 minutes)
Step 69. Apply a leave-in treatment (3 minutes)
Step 70. Air dry the hair for a few minutes before rolling (10 minutes)
Step 71. Position the roller at the nape of the neck (1 minute)
Step 72. Check the final curl pattern in the mirror (2 minutes)
Step 73. Wind the hair tightly around the foam (1 minute)
Step 74. Prepare the setting lotion (2 minutes)
Step 75. Search for the wide-tooth comb (5 minutes)
Step 76. Wash the hairbrush (10 minutes)
Step 77. Section the hair into four main quadrants (5 minutes)
Step 78. Blot the hair gently with a microfiber towel (4 minutes)
Step 79. Place the rollers in a storage bag (2 minutes)
Step 80. Tuck any stray hairs into the roller (1 minute)
